exact_first_paragraph_markdown: I used to preach [Buddhist enlightenment](http://mindset.u-dont-exist.com/) a lot. Then I noticed I could feel spiritually free and still turn right back into the same little kid when an old wound got hit. Whatever had become free in me hadn't reached that kid. I started thinking most people who chase spiritual freedom are partly trying to get above childhood pain, or get away from parts of ourselves we don't want to meet. That's [spiritual bypassing](https://goenka.u-dont-exist.com/). I think plenty of seekers and gurus do it too; I've written about the [Dalai Lama as one example](https://substack.com/@udontexist/note/c-245314772?r=5vdc6m).
